purpose: Define stable MCP server identity separately from executable command, process handle, URL, socket, transport session and advertised server display name.

topics.name: MCP Server Identity
topics.purpose: Define stable MCP server identity separately from executable command, process handle, URL, socket, transport session and advertised server display name.

semantics.identity_rule: Each configured MCP server has an explicit stable logical identity.
semantics.binding_rule: Transport/process binding locates or starts the server but is not the semantic identity.
semantics.display_rule: Advertised server name/display metadata is descriptive only unless explicitly mapped.
semantics.rebinding_rule: Compatible transport rebinding preserves server identity.
semantics.provenance_rule: Tool/resource advertisements retain the server identity that supplied them.

invariants.rule: MCP server identity, transport, tool schema, lifecycle and authority remain explicit and do not inherit trust from connectivity or advertised metadata.

hard_gates.condition: URL/process command used as sole semantic server identity
display name trusted as canonical identity without mapping
reconnect creates new semantic server identity
tool advertisement loses originating server provenance
same active server identity maps to conflicting bindings without explicit multi-binding semantics

references.purpose: Server identity remains separate from mutable transport binding.

prose.summary: Define stable MCP server identity separately from executable command, process handle, URL, socket, transport session and advertised server display name.
